notes.title: Full version of Lesson Learned in May
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

Today, I come to you with some super news! You've probably already spent some time with Amelia in our free prologue [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/][b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b][/url]. Soon you will be able to join me in the full version of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/][b]Lesson Learned[/b][/url]. The game will be released on [b]29 May 2024[/b] on [b]Steam [/b]and [b]Xbox[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/99008f8c95eff7034497c056397a88624441fae0.png[/img]

It all started in history class... It was so boring there that I fell asleep at my desk! I don't even remember what the topic of the lesson was. Prehistory? Or maybe the French Revolution? Definitely something about the past. Who would have thought that suddenly I was about to embark on a journey through a bizarre world made of historical eras!

There are enemies lurking at every step. We will need defensive towers to ward off attacks. With crossbows! And bombs! My classmates will be with me, but you can invite your friends too. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/][b]Lesson Learned[/b][/url] is a game best played in co-op mode on a split screen. Collecting materials and building more towers will almost feel like a group project! Together, we can tackle any opponent.

[h3]Watch the teaser announcing the date of Lesson Learned:[/h3]

[previewyoutube=RC2FGmXwU6E;full][/previewyoutube]
I can't wait for you to finally join me. For now, play the free prologue [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/][b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b][/url], where Amelia will teach you the key mechanics. No one knows defensive towers like she does. She will show you everything you need to defeat the bloody Countess Elizabeth Bathory, whose troops are coming your way.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/

Remember to join the class [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url]. We can devise the best strategies together there. Also add Lesson Learned to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/]wishlist[/url] on Steam so you won't miss the premiere!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/

See you later friends,
Frank and Gaming Factory

[url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/b4aa14b19af35dc42956fc3309ae8dd408f47742.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Release of the prologue!
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

The subject of today’s lesson is something you’ve all been waiting for! Free prologue [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/?beta=0][b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b][/url] is now available on Steam and Xbox.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/?beta=0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/46beee46d0e4a3ca20704c97313c6bb0c6905b02.png[/img][/url]

Join my friend Amelia on the journey across a bizarre daydream world in the first campaign mode in the series. Gather your minions and build many different defense towers which will be necessary to fight back waves of enemies. It’s almost like dodgeball! But with monsters and weapons. Do you think I could use that to do better at PE? 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/?beta=0][b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b][/url] is an introduction to the base game, which lets you discover the mechanics and types of towers you will be able to use in next campaigns. Your first quest will be to defeat Elizabeth Bathory! Yes, this world is filled with historical figures, and the first one you need to stand against is the bloodthirsty Countess. 

[i]Watch the release trailer for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/?beta=0]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/url] and see what we have to fight with:[/i]

[previewyoutube=Dn931WZhZ4Y;full][/previewyoutube]
We know that studying is better with friends. That’s why Lesson Learned and the prologue can be played in solo or co-op mode. Gather friends and together think of the best ways to fight back enemies.

And that is not all! The full version of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/]Lesson Learned[/url][/b] is coming soon. Campaign mode with different types of enemies and boss fights await you. Amelia will teach you the mechanics in the prologue, and then you can join me in the base game to fight back more enemies.

Join our class [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url], where we can talk about the best strategies how to defeat enemies from the past. Who knows, maybe we could use this knowledge to pass the history exam. Add[b] Lesson Learned[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/]wishlist[/url] to not miss the news about the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/?beta=0


See you in the next class,
Frank & Gaming Factory
